name: Truck Insurance Cancellations by State
pitch: Trucking companies whose federal liability insurance filing was cancelled and not replaced this week, for truck insurance agencies: the carrier must refile within days or lose its authority to run

provenAbroad.what: Same model, other sellers in the US market: TruckerDB sells daily new DOT carrier lists plus insurance renewal alerts to agents, dispatchers and lenders; Stripe-verified $1,630 MRR on 20 subscriptions, founded April 2026
New Trucking Companies sells FMCSA insurance filing and suspension alerts by state from $39 a month with a 7-day trial

buyer.who: Independent insurance agencies that write commercial truck insurance (a subset of the 37,000 US independent P&C agencies; the trucking share is not counted)
buyer.countNote: all independent P&C agencies; trucking writers not counted
buyer.reach: Agencies list their business inbox and phone on their own websites; trade roundups of truck insurance agencies link to them

price.reason: A cancelled carrier is a hotter lead than a new one (it already buys cover and must replace it now); TruckerDB charges $99 for the tier that adds insurance renewals

competitors.name: New Trucking Companies, 1 state (includes insurance filing events)

data.publisher: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (US DOT open data portal, Socrata)
data.dataset: Motus InsHist, All With History (3uet-3z4i), joined to the Company Census File (az4n-8mr2) for name and state
data.subject: a carrier's cancelled federal insurance filing (form, insurer, effective and cancel dates, USDOT and docket number)
data.recordsNote: Counted Oct 23, 2026: 2,112 distinct carriers with a BMC-91X liability filing cancelled (status CANCEL, not TERM/REPL) effective in Sept 2026; 2,170 rows (9,489 more were replaced). Aug 2026: 3,560 rows. Not yet split by state or filtered to business entities (needs the census join). FMCSA says Motus insurance data is updated daily; the portal showed rows updated Oct 18, so weekly is what we can promise.
data.privacy: Join to the census and keep only carriers whose legal name carries an entity suffix; drop officer, cell phone and email fields. Policy numbers stay out of the product.
data.apiNote: Motus replaced the legacy insurance datasets in 2026 (this one created Jun 3, 2026; the pending-insurance history file stopped May 14, 2026), so ids may change again

license.note: FMCSA says it shares its census and safety data at no charge to the public; the page sets no resale or reuse limits, only disclaimers (a snapshot, informational only, no government liability). The portal metadata (api/views/metadata/v1) carries Rights: public and no license field. No restriction found; a US government work. Reviewer should confirm no separate DOT portal terms apply.

overlap: Shares source, buyer and reach with fmcsa-new-trucking-companies; best sold as a second tier of the same product
risks: Many cancellations are carriers leaving the business, not shopping for cover. Motus data quality was reported as messy after the May 2026 launch (Overdrive coverage via Fusable, Jun 15, 2026).
